text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Sakura Chiyono O said she wanted 
to stop by the convenience store, so while 
waiting for her—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~! Sorry for dragging 
you along with me!
choice_data_list:
Were you able to buy what you were looking 
for?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I was able to get all the little 
animal stickers!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! They're animal stickers my little 
sister and I have been collecting lately.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They come as a bonus with the juice, but 
they have animal trivia on them so it's 
educational, and above all, every single 
one is super cute!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My big brothers are helping out too, so 
we've gathered quite a lot of them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The ones I don't have yet are 
Pronghorn-chan, Dolphin-chan, and 
Cheetah-chan, I think. I hope I pull them~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O immediately opened the 
sticker pack. And then—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Pronghorn-chan! Yay~! So cool~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, "Pronghorn-chan has incredible 
stamina! She loses to Cheetah-chan in 
sprints, but she won't lose over long 
distances!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. It makes sense, but even 
among animals, some are suited for sprints 
and others for long distances, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's just as they say... 'Cherry blossoms 
grow in the mountains, seaweed grows in 
the sea'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, those are magnificent horns. I'd 
love to see them in person.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I know! If you'd like, would you want to 
go watch it together sometime?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. It'd be so nice if there was one at 
a nearby zoo~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, Sakura Chiyono O was 
delighted to have pulled the sticker she 
was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, look, a dolphin! Whoa, so cute~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Here's some trivia... "Dolphins are 
aquatic mammals that live in pods! They 
swim fast, and rumor has it they're 
actually super smart... maybe?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, come to think of it, I remember 
going to an aquarium with my family to see 
a show long ago.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's incredible, you know! She can even 
jump super high and everything!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A fast swimmer and smart too... "An 
all-rounder is an entertainer," isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, excuse me, just a moment...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hello? What's wrong? ...Yeah, mm-hmm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
T-T-Trainer-san, this is amazing! It's 
from my younger sister, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"It seems my little sister just drew a 
dolphin plushie of her own right now!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! It totally linked up 
with my proverb! You're a true 
entertainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, taking inspiration from 
'Dolphin-chan,' we decided on a 
well-rounded training session for that 
day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Cheetah-chan! Yay! My little sister 
really wanted this~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Cheetah-chan has amazing acceleration! 
She's unbeatable at short distances! She's 
got great style, and she's so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You see footage of cheetahs running at 
incredible speeds all the time, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If you could unleash that kind of speed in 
the final stretch, it'd be one incredible 
weapon...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's just like they say: 'A great weapon 
is the shortest path to victory!'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
? Huh, the sibling LANE group is super 
lively. I wonder what's up?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, it looks like my big brothers got a 
pronghorn plushie and a dolphin plushie!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... we completed it?! 
Awesome!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have to tell her soon too! "I... 
Cheetah-chan too..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Immediately afterward, a phone call came 
in from her excited younger sister.
